mapper.delete: DELETE FROM hls_doc_layout_config_lov WHERE config_id IN ( SELECT config_id FROM hls_doc_layout_config WHERE layout_code = #{docLayoutTab.layoutCode} AND tab_code =#{docLayoutTab.tabCode} )
mapper.select: select count(*) from hls_doc_layout_config_lov a where a.config_id = #{config_id} and lower(a.lov_col_name) = lower(#{lov_col_name})

SELECT t1.COLUMN_NAME columnName, t1.PROMPT prompt, t1.DISPLAY_ORDER displayOrder, t1.INPUT_MODE inputMode, t1.INPUT_MODE inputModeDesc FROM HLS_DOC_LAYOUT_CONFIG t1
t1.enabled_flag ='Y' AND t1.display_flag='Y' AND t1.layout_code=#{param.layoutCode} AND t1.tab_code=#{param.tabCode}
AND t1.COLUMN_NAME LIKE concat('%', concat(#{param.columnName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))
AND t1.PROMPT LIKE concat('%', concat(#{param.prompt,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))
ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_ORDER
